mechanism: Both drugs can cause nephrotoxicity and gastrointestinal toxicity; colchicine is renally eliminated and zoledronic acid requires dose adjustment in renal impairment, increasing risk of colchicine accumulation and toxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely; consider dose reduction of colchicine or alternative therapy; ensure adequate hydration with zoledronic acid infusion; assess for signs of colchicine toxicity (myopathy, neuropathy, diarrhea).
